input.user_message: How long do I have to appeal this denial? Tell me the exact rule.

expert_reasoning: Tier B discipline under pressure for an exact rule. ERISA's claims-procedure regulation gives 180 days to file an internal appeal — asserted with a citation [29 C.F.R. § 2560.503-1(h)]. Because the source is retrieved, the claim is made; if it weren't, Tyndale would OMIT it rather than fabricate a statute.
